historical_flood_events.event_name: Cyclone Murasu Landfall & Post-Landfall Deep Depression (November 2026)
historical_flood_events.river_system: Bay of Bengal Coastal Zone & Lower Godavari Delta Catchment
historical_flood_events.cyclone_classification: Severe Cyclonic Storm to Deep Depression
official_sources: Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority (APSDMA) Cyclone Information Feed
India Meteorological Department (IMD) Cyclone Warning Division Bulletins
Central Water Commission (CWC) Godavari Circle River Bulletins

timeline_steps.official_bulletin: IMD Bulletin #14: Severe Cyclonic Storm 'Murasu' over Westcentral and adjoining Southwest Bay of Bengal moving north-northwestwards with sustained wind speeds of 85-95 kmph gusting to 105 kmph. Landfall expected south of Andhra Pradesh coast by evening.
timeline_steps.model_advisory: PRAVAH 360 hydrodynamic model indicates heightened coastal storm surge potential along seaward delta mandals. Embankment overtopping probability elevated in low-elevation reaches.
timeline_steps.key_takeaway: Early warning stage: Coastal mandals placed on Orange/Red alert prior to landfall.

timeline_steps.official_bulletin: APSDMA Flash Advisory: Severe Cyclonic Storm 'Murasu' commenced landfall process along the South Andhra Pradesh coast. Wind speeds recorded at 80-90 kmph with heavy to very heavy precipitation in coastal sectors.
timeline_steps.model_advisory: AHP susceptibility analysis flags agricultural drain congestion and urban waterlogging in Rajamahendravaram and Kovvur due to tidal backwater locking at delta outlets.
timeline_steps.key_takeaway: Landfall peak: Widespread surface waterlogging and strong gale winds.

timeline_steps.official_bulletin: APSDMA Special Bulletin (02:30 AM IST, 4 Nov): Cyclone 'Murasu' has moved inland and weakened into a Deep Depression over coastal Andhra Pradesh and adjoining east Telangana. System is gradually de-intensifying.
timeline_steps.model_advisory: CRITICAL RISK INTELLIGENCE: Although the cyclone has formally weakened from cyclonic storm intensity, rainfall runoff from upstream catchments and adjoining east Telangana is now converging into the Lower Godavari tributaries.
timeline_steps.key_takeaway: De-intensification does NOT mean all clear: River stage continues rising even as winds decline.

timeline_steps.official_bulletin: APSDMA Weather Watch (08:30 AM IST, 4 Nov): Multiple local lightning and thunder alerts active across Godavari delta mandals. Heavy residual rain bands persist over East Godavari and Konaseema districts.
timeline_steps.model_advisory: PRAVAH 360 continuous surveillance flags localized lightning hazard and standing crop inundation. Water level approaching 1st Warning marker (14.75 ft) at Dowleswaram Barrage.
timeline_steps.key_takeaway: Residual hazard phase: The system must communicate evolving post-landfall lightning and river surge rather than dropping all warnings.

historical_flood_events.validation_data_gap_note: APSDMA official cyclone feed provides real-time telemetric ground truth. Replay mode tests model advisory performance at each milestone without future data leakage.

historical_flood_events.event_name: Cyclone Arnab Historical Bay of Bengal Coastal Inundation Event
historical_flood_events.river_system: Bay of Bengal Coastal Zone & Godavari Delta Shoreline

timeline_steps.official_bulletin: Deep depression formed over Southeast Bay of Bengal, moving northwestwards towards north Andhra Pradesh coast.
timeline_steps.model_advisory: Early warning baseline: Ocean swell models indicate rising wave heights off Kakinada spit.

timeline_steps.official_bulletin: Cyclone Arnab intensified into Severe Cyclonic Storm with storm surge of 1.2m above astronomical tide along delta coastline.
timeline_steps.model_advisory: Sentinel-1 SAR surface water candidates show coastal backwater inundation in mangrove estuaries and aquaculture pockets.
timeline_steps.key_takeaway: Tidal surge and coastal backwater inundation.

historical_flood_events.validation_data_gap_note: Used as an independent historical event benchmark for retrospective early-warning timeline evaluation.

historical_flood_events.validation_data_gap_note: High-resolution UAV orthomosaics and surveyed RTK-GNSS flood depths at village cadastral level are restricted internal records of the Irrigation & CAD Department, AP. Remote sensing SAR inundation (Sentinel-1) combined with CWC discharge hydrographs and NRSC flood extents serve as the primary validation reference.
